pages.title: Morning mist · 1/3
paragraphs: It is six in the morning at a quiet lake near Minneapolis. Mist floats over the water like a white blanket. Eva walks along the shore with a borrowed rod. An old man sits on a bucket near the dock. His name is Walt and he fishes every morning. She walks over with a friendly hello.
“Good morning! Is this a good place to fish?” says Eva. “Yes. The best fish are near the old dock.” says Walt. “What bait works better, worms or bread?” says Eva.
